messages:
incident-bot: :warning: High anomaly: sudden surge in routing re-evaluations + repeated fallback activity. Smart-routing policy is picking non-prod variants for production tenants. Auto-pager issued to on-call.
Maya: oncall ack. seeing elevated 5xxs for customers in eu-central and lots of `chosen_variant= v2-beta` where policy should have selected v1-stable.
Sanjay: digging into the decision_events stream — many events have route_tags empty string or missing entirely. also fallback_reason is absent. makes it impossible to see why fallback happened.
Lee: logs show pattern: eu pool returns 503 -> router marks as unavailable -> policy sends to nearest fallback (us-east) -> us-east rate limits -> router tries another region -> oscillation. re-route count per request > 3.
Cassie: v2-beta has a known memory growth issue on certain payload shapes (we've been testing it). customers hitting v2-beta see increased latency and occasional OOM 500s.
Arjun: can we emergency-pin affected tenants to v1-stable and suspend auto-fallback for that tenant group?
Maya: i'm creating a targeted override now. command: `rbctl routing override create --scope tenant:acct-22* --variant v1-stable --ttl 3600`
Maya: pushed. override active in ~45s.
Sanjay: still seeing some traffic bouncing while caches clear. I recommend disabling region_fallback for the override scope until we stabilize.
Lee: applying policy patch: ```
# emergency: suspend cross-region fallback for pinned tenants
policies.smart_routing.scopes["tenant:acct-22*"] = {"allow_region_fallback": false}
```
ops-bot: Emergency config change applied. Change ID cfg-78921. Rolling out to router fleet.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: escalation to SRE and Infra teams 0m ago. PD incident link: https://pd.example/INC-99871
Mika: observability issue: traces and APM spans only record `router.service` and a short note "routed". No route_tags, no rule_id, and no fallback_reason. We need these fields in both traces and decision logs.
Sanjay: enabling verbose decision events for 20 minutes: `rbctl logs set-level router debug --component decision --sample 1.0 --duration 20m`
Sanjay: patch ready to include additional fields in the event emitter: ```
- emit({chosen_variant, reason})
+ emit({chosen_variant, reason, rule_id: rule.id || "<unknown>", route_tags: rule.tags || [], fallback_reason: ctx.fallback_reason || null})
```
Cassie: will that require a restart? If it's purely a serialization change it should be hot-deployable. we need a quick code review and an infra-approved hotpatch.
Arjun: i can fast-review. infra, please prioritize hotpatch on router. @ops-bot?
ops-bot: Hotpatch approved for router v1.18. Canary rollout starting now (5 nodes). Rollback window 10 minutes.
Lee: after pin + fallback disable: 5xx rate dropped from 7.8% -> 0.9% within 6 minutes for affected tenants. cross-region egress reduced ~78%.
Mika: creating ticket for tracing + logs: LOGS-4532. Owner: cassie. Objective: add rule_id/route_tags/fallback_reason to both decision events and spans; instrument sampling so first-error always includes full metadata.
Cassie: customer impact break down: estimated 2300 failed requests, 14 tenants with >1% error increase, highest impact on tx-ingest endpoint. notified customer success.
Maya: bridging for post-incident review in 15. tagging cassie + sanjay as postmortem leads.
Sanjay: immediate follow-ups: 1) permanent addition of route_tags and fallback_reason to all decision events; 2) add an alert when decision_event.route_tags is missing or empty; 3) add unit tests validating policy matcher does not match experimental variants for production scopes; 4) run chaos/replay test simulating eu pool 503 to verify routing stability.
Arjun: opened MR for decision_event schema change and trace enrichment: https://git.redwood/infra/router/merge_requests/513. includes tests and doc updates.
Cassie: i'll draft timeline, root cause: (a) policy matcher had an edge-case condition matching v2-beta for org pattern `acct-22*`, (b) router currently allowed missing route_tags, (c) cross-region fallback logic lacked backoff leading to loops.
Mika: adding runbook item: verify route_tags present in decision event before promoting any router code to production.
Maya: moving to handoff: oncall remains until postmortem created. tagged follow-ups in INC-99871.
incident-bot: Status update: mitigated -> monitoring. Postmortem assigned.
Maya: thanks team. good catch on the logs gap. leaving emergency overrides active until we validate fixes in staging and run the replay. will update customers via CS.
